query: Which measurable success metrics will demonstrate REC uptake of findings, and what indicators will detect recruitment bias and analytic saturation in our interviews and coding?

response.query: Which measurable success metrics will demonstrate REC uptake of findings, and what indicators will detect recruitment bias and analytic saturation in our interviews and coding?
response.answer: REC uptake metrics include publication rates and citation counts; recruitment bias indicators are demographic mismatches, while analytic saturation is detected when no new themes emerge in coding.
